thread:
michelle: quick thread — enterprise customers asking for a more graceful pin/unpin flow. proposing a 'soft-pin' TTL that auto-expires after a configurable number of days.

michelle: sketch:
```
pin: {
  model_id: "gpt-like-2026",
  pin_type: "soft",
  pin_ttl_days: 90,
  reason: "customer-request",
}
```

michelle: want feedback on feasibility, security, billing, and launch criteria.

devin: @michelle quick Q — do we need routing changes or can this be metadata-only that the router ignores until TTL ends?

ryan: it can be metadata-driven. core work: persist TTL on the pin record + background unpin job + audit trail. also UI changes for the Console and a few API extensions. very roughly: 2 engineers x 2 sprints for a safe rollout (incl e2e & canary).

sarah: CS signal — at least 3 large customers asked for extended pin windows last quarter. migration ops cost is real; 90d default seems reasonable. we need a migration playbook if auto-unpin fails.

alejandro: sales note — customers will pay for guaranteed pin windows. propose tiered add-on: 30/90/180 day paid extensions. need billing hooks to surface invoiceable pin requests.

devin: minimal API idea: add `pin_ttl_days` to `POST /pins` and `unpin_reason` enum. backend job runs hourly to expire pins. emit `pin_auto_unpinned` event for observability.

michelle: proposed launch acceptance criteria:
- e2e: pin -> auto-unpin works across hosted / dedicated / private
- canary: small set of dedicated pockets + 2 customers
- metrics: `active_pins_by_ttl`, `auto_unpin_rate` with target failure <= 1%
- docs & billing flow completed

ryan: rollout plan: canary in next sprint (+14d), monitor 2 weeks. include rollback gate and an immediate `unpin` API for ops. caution: cache invalidation (prefix/KV) must honor pin TTL metadata.

sarah: please add a migration email template and a short runbook. CS wants a checkbox in the UI for customers to opt into assisted/manual migration vs auto-unpin.

michelle: action items and tentative owners/dates:
- @ryan: scope infra + ETA (due: 1768006000)
- @devin: API + job design + spec (due: 1768007000)
- @sarah: draft CS playbook + email template (due: 1768006500)
- @alejandro: pricing proposal + customer contract language (due: 1768008000)

michelle: planning a 30m sync Tue 10am to lock tradeoffs. drop +1 or thoughts here :+1: :thinking:
